sections.text:
[Effects]
Reduces physical and magic damage taken by M.
Reduces physical damage taken by S.
Reduces magic damage taken by S.
Damage reduction scales with the number of Fire elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
L
Activation rate scales with the number of Fire elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
